meta.name: generating-api-sdks
meta.description:
Generate client SDKs in multiple languages from OpenAPI specifications.
Use when generating client libraries for API consumption.
Trigger with phrases like "generate SDK", "create client library", or "build API SDK".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成多语言客户端库,只需提供 OpenAPI 规格
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你需要为团队快速生成多种语言的 API 客户端库
copy.tagline_en: Generate client libraries in multiple languages from your OpenAPI spec.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate typed clients for multiple languages from your OpenAPI definitions.

howto.what: 根据 OpenAPI 3.0+ 规范生成客户端 SDK。读取并验证规范,提取操作与模型,生成 TypeScript、Python、Go 等语言的类型安全库,包含认证、重试和分页支持,并输出到 sdk 目录及其文档和测试。
howto.when: 当你说出“generate SDK”、“create client library”、“build API SDK”等触发词,或明确要求根据 OpenAPI 规范生成客户端库时触发。

say.text: 根据这个 OpenAPI 文件生成 TypeScript SDK
say.note: 会生成 client.ts 及类型定义

say.text: 为我的 API 创建 Python 客户端库
say.note: 生成含异步支持的 Python SDK

say.text: 从这个 OpenAPI 规范生成 Go 和 Java 的 SDK
say.note: 同时产出两个语言版本及文档

howto.what_en: Generates client SDKs from OpenAPI 3.0+ specs. Reads and validates the spec, extracts operations and models, then produces type-safe libraries for TypeScript, Python, Go, Java, etc., with auth, retry, and pagination support, outputting code, docs, and tests under an sdk/ folder.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say phrases like 'generate SDK', 'create client library', 'build API SDK', or ask to build a client library from an OpenAPI spec.

say_en.text: Generate a TypeScript SDK from this OpenAPI file
Create a Python client library for my API
say_en.note: Produces Python SDK with async support

say_en.text: Generate Go and Java SDKs from this OpenAPI spec
say_en.note: Outputs both language versions plus docs
